meta.name: revenue-recognition
meta.description: Determines when and how revenue is recognized — performance obligations, contract terms that change the answer, and the deal structures that create accounting problems. Use this to work out how a contract should be recognized, review a non-standard deal before it is signed, understand deferred revenue, or spot terms that would delay or reverse recognition.

copy.tagline: 判断合同收入该何时入账,提前发现影响确认的条款
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常为复杂合同的收入确认时点发愁。
copy.tagline_en: Find out when a contract's revenue should hit the books.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you deal with complex contracts and wonder when to recognize revenue.

howto.what: 该技能使 Claude 能够解答合同收入如何确认的问题：按五步法识别履约义务、分摊交易价格，并提示有哪些条款会改变确认时点。
howto.when: 当你要求计算合同应如何确认收入、审查签署前的非标准交易、理解递延收入等时触发。

say.text: 帮我看看这份合同，收入确认应该怎么做？
say.note: Claude 按五步法拆解合同并给出确认时点。

say.text: 合同里有验收条款，会影响收入确认吗？
say.note: Claude 会检查该条款是否推迟确认。

say.text: 递延收入这部分该怎么分解和跟踪？
say.note: Claude 会说明按履约义务归类的方法。

howto.what_en: This skill lets Claude handle revenue recognition questions: it applies the five-step method to identify performance obligations, allocate price, and highlight terms that affect recognition timing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask how a contract should be recognized, review a non-standard deal, or understand deferred revenue.

say_en.text: Help me figure out how to recognize revenue for this contract.
say_en.note: Claude will apply the five-step framework to the contract.

say_en.text: This contract has acceptance clauses — do they affect recognition?
say_en.note: Claude will assess the clause's impact.

say_en.text: How should I track the deferred revenue balance?
say_en.note: Claude will explain grouping by obligation.
